text:
I am a loyal and frequent customer of this location and visit nearly every morning. The treatment I received was unacceptable.

On December 25, 2025, I placed an online order for pickup at Restaurant 39148. When I arrived, the restaurant was closed due to Christmas. I fully understand holiday closures. However, the online ordering system did not indicate that this location was closed or unavailable for pickup, resulting in payment for an order I could not receive.

I returned the following morning to retrieve my order or request a refund. Instead of assistance, I was met with hostility and accusations of dishonesty from the managers on duty. I was told I was lying because they claimed no orders were received the prior day. Even after presenting clear proof of purchase and payment from my debit card, I continued to be treated as though I was attempting to defraud the company.

One manager walked away from the register in visible frustration before completing my order. Another manager’s demeanor implied that I was stealing from the brand. The tone set by management caused the entire staff to treat me with suspicion. I was humiliated and discredited in front of others, despite being a daily customer of this location.

I clearly stated that I was willing to accept a refund. My concern is not the food but the conduct. Accusing a customer of dishonesty, disregarding documented proof, and responding with contempt reflects a serious failure in leadership and customer service.

McDonald’s is a respected global brand, and this experience fell far below its standards. I am requesting a review of this incident and appropriate corrective action to ensure customers are treated with professionalism and respect.
author: Mariah Kamara (Naomi)

text:
The food was great, and the service was exceptional—exactly what you’d expect from a global brand. However, something in the store left me shocked and deeply hurt.

On the wall map, Kashmir was shown as part of another country. I want to ask—who designed or approved this map? How can such a serious misrepresentation be displayed so casually in a global outlet?

Let me be clear:
Kashmir was a part of India, is a part of India, and will always be a part of India.

This kind of error is not just incorrect—it’s offensive and disrespectful to the sovereignty and sentiments of millions of Indians. I urge McDonald’s global management to take immediate action to correct the map and ensure this does not happen again. As a global brand, you have a responsibility to be accurate and sensitive to geopolitical realities.

Please treat this issue with the seriousness it deserves.
author: Sirisha Krishna

text: Place very nicely located.  Quiet neighborhood.  Mc Donald building nice.  The order was quickly brought, but unfortunately everything is cold ... Fries and a sandwich ... They have forgotten about the other set for my daughter ... Service not very nice.  I have a tax exemption card .... The shock - the manager began to explain that in all points of McDonald's it is accepted but not on Thai one .... Nonsense!!!  It would be good to train managers and cashires... In the end, the US government card should be honored everywhere .... The international menu can be forgotten if we talk about sandwiches ... There are only salads ... Served without bun which was on the ad ..  .. Generally a lot to improve in the field of customer service ... But I must admit that generally clean.
author: K B (kristoferos)

text: While I was enjoying my food, their cleaners were mopping the floor at my feet with her mop. They are not worried about the risk of customers slipping. And the water is mixed with the smell of disinfectant in this small room. And when I proposed to her that it made me very uncomfortable, she continued her work. I would understand if it was close to getting off work, but it was only 7 p.m. I can't believe this is a global McDonald's service.
author: Zhijie Ma

text: When for global indian menu, it wast on list. We were ordering at 10:58am from global menu. We needed something for normal menu the cashier told us kitchen opens at 11am so she will only take order after 11am. We told her it’s only 2 mins away and she was like yes comeback for 2nd order after 11am. Ridiculous but we obliged. Great place but shady location.
author: Prajakta Masurkar

text: Leider sind momentan nicht sehr viele Länder vertreten - wir hätten aufgrund der Werbung mehr als ca. acht vertretene Länder erwartet. Die Bezeichnung „Global“ ist übertrieben und so haben wir uns nicht über die schlechte Kunden-Frequenz wundern müssen. Anscheinend hat sich dies schon rumgesprochen.
author: Tschortsch Zuercher

text: CONSTANTLY and I mean constantly lets orders get stolen because they don't verify with deliver personnel. Overcrowded kitchen with more people standing around doing nothing. Half the staff doesn't speak English. Global menu is incredibly limited. Hard pass and another L for quality with McDonald's.
author: Quatro Bajeena

text: Very disappointing “global menu”. There was only 3 items available; bbq chicken sandwich, special flavor nuggets, and a dessert. They have the complete US menu and the food was fresh and the staff were great. However I expected there to be a variety of items, not only 3.
author: Savannah Stroup

text: Me dijeron que tenía hamburguesas de muchos países pero solo cuenta con 4 o 5 hamburguesas diferentes y la que ordene no me gustó, tenía hongos y varios quesos y aderezos con hojuelas amargas. No vale la pena ir solo para conocer o probar.
author: Gricelda Martinez-vences (Gris)

text:
The ‘global’ label feels more like a marketing gimmick…most dishes and many countries are missing.

From India, they only have the McAloo Tikki, and even that doesn’t compare to the one back home. Don’t come in with high expectations.
author: Deepthi Pai Manoor
